tasks.title: Implement a file-based Kanban and agent coordination workflow
acceptance: A generated Markdown Kanban, per-task cards and JSON view share the canonical ledger and refresh under its lock.
Agents can atomically claim the next eligible task, report progress/heartbeat, block, resume and release without stealing ownership.
Claims respect dependencies, authorization, priority and overlapping task paths; stale reports never imply reassignment.
Concurrency, ownership, stale snapshots and publication failure behavior have meaningful host tests.
Agent instructions explain the complete workflow and its local-filesystem limits.
steps: Add generated planning views and task readiness/ownership metadata.
Extend atomic CLI transitions and protect file ownership.
Test concurrency and failure cases, document and record host evidence.
tasks.progress_note: 42 tests, 99 local links and view consistency checks passed; original tasks/evidence and permissions preserved
tasks.next_step: Record host evidence and complete the coordination task

tasks.title: Prepare and verify the project foundation
acceptance: The CLI passes checks; competing agents cannot claim the same task.
Documentation, the source registry and the initial backlog exist.
No command writes to phone partitions.
steps: Test the CLI and negative cases.
Save actual verification results and generate STATUS.md.

tasks.title: Pin S24 upstream and document donor provenance
acceptance: The exact S24 checkout is pinned to a full commit SHA; the working tree does not modify upstream.
Selected donors have a SHA, license and documented purpose.
Authored, build-tested and device-observed statuses are distinct.
steps: Read research/sources.json.
Clone only selected sources into references/ without downloading firmware/IPSW.
Create a reuse/replace/missing map.

tasks.title: Collect sanitized read-only S24 inventory
acceptance: Model, codename and firmware are measured rather than assumed.
Unlock status is separate from root; root is not requested automatically.
The report contains no IMEI/serial numbers and does not change phone settings.
steps: Wait for authorized ADB connectivity; do not pair automatically.
Run tools/device_inventory.py with a fresh output path.
Save evidence with local-device origin.

tasks.title: Cross-check the e1s hardware map against primary sources
acceptance: CPU/GIC/timer/RAM/UFS/touch/GPU are documented with DTS/source references.
Unknown and firmware-dependent values are explicit.
No MMIO probes run on the live phone.
steps: Compare DTS with upstream tables.
Create a hardware table with provenance.
Prepare only synthetic parser fixtures.

tasks.title: Make the host loader and E1S delta build reproducible
acceptance: Toolchain and upstream versions are pinned.
A build or its precise failure is reproducible from a clean environment.
check_all_exports failures and incomplete builds are not reported as successful boot.
Images stay in artifacts/; no flashing.
steps: Start with the loader without Apple userland.
Save commands, exit codes, versions and hashes.
Document SDK availability and its authorized source separately.

tasks.title: Validate the boot package, ADT and memory boundaries on the host
acceptance: Negative cases cover reserved-memory overlap, invalid size and invalid entry address.
QEMU virt and screen previews are labeled synthetic.
No Exynos 2400 hardware emulation is claimed.
steps: Create small synthetic fixtures.
Validate structures and ranges without executing on the phone.
Publish verification limitations.

tasks.title: Design an Android app for GUI/GPU measurements
acceptance: The APK needs no root, Device Admin, accessibility or partition writes.
Stop, timeout, load limits and sanitized result export are documented.
A minimal Vulkan baseline and frame comparison criteria are defined.
steps: Start with short offscreen tests.
Define the report format and a dedicated app directory.
Plan clean termination and GPU timeout handling.

tasks.title: Implement a minimal Android Vulkan probe
acceptance: The APK builds with a pinned toolchain.
Versions, source commit and APK SHA256 are recorded.
Stop/timeout tests run on an available host/emulator; limitations are explicit.
The APK is not installed on the primary phone without authorized android-app scope.
steps: Implement the minimal probe and JSON export.
Test lifecycle and timeout.
Prepare a reviewable APK and instructions.

tasks.title: Measure stock Vulkan on the S24 inside Android
acceptance: Dated inventory and the APK hash are available.
Renderer, extensions, frame results and temperature observations are saved.
Stop is tested without rebooting; negative cases are documented.
steps: Proceed only after app installation is authorized.
Run short tests using the stock driver, without a stress loop.
Establish a baseline before changing drivers.

tasks.title: Validate a minimal Metal-to-Vulkan path on the host
acceptance: Shader fixtures are project-owned or have a verified license.
Reference pixels and permitted error are documented.
Host pass is not presented as Xclipse/XNU pass.
steps: Select one compute/render example.
Pin the translator and SPIR-V format.
Compare with reference output.

tasks.title: Compare the stock driver and Xclipse RADV in the test APK
acceptance: RADV loads only inside the test process, without system library replacement.
Each build and shader set has a revision/hash.
Compare correctness, stability and frame time; preserve failures.
steps: Check app-local loading on the measured firmware.
Start with one frame and a short timeout.
On GPU hang, stop the series and preserve available logs.

tasks.title: Prepare an STM SPI touch driver and host adapter
acceptance: The protocol is separated from the MMIO layer.
The parser is tested with truncated/invalid events and coordinate ranges.
Device power, IRQ and sensor behavior remain labeled unverified.
steps: Use project-owned protocol fixtures.
Preserve licenses and provenance for reused code.
Do not read MMIO on the daily Android system.

tasks.title: Validate the read-only UFS/MCQ contract on the host
acceptance: Checks cover DMA/GPT/LUN boundaries, timeouts and rejection of write commands.
Reading encrypted Android userdata is not assumed possible.
Hardware PHY/IOMMU/MCQ compatibility is not claimed without measurements.
steps: Validate a minimal command allowlist.
Model completion failures and incomplete responses.
Describe the RAM root for an initial boot.

tasks.title: Prepare a verifiable recovery plan for this exact S24
acceptance: The exact model, firmware/bootloader and an available recovery path are known.
Backups have a date, size, hash and location outside Git.
Backup availability is distinct from tested recovery; untested steps are not marked ready.
This task does not itself authorize partition operations.
steps: Describe the recovery path without executing write commands.
List missing observations.
Prepare a separate proposal for a hardware session.

tasks.title: Design control and return paths for a native test
acceptance: Document where ADB becomes unavailable and the independent control plane.
Watchdog/one-shot boot have a separate validation plan.
Document manual fallback and conditions prohibiting an autonomous loop.
steps: Do not promise return via Stop before measuring it.
Plan a RAM root with no personal data access.
Separate software timeout from hardware watchdog.

tasks.title: Run the first native BOOT session with logs and recovery
acceptance: A concrete hardware session and its changes have separate explicit authorization.
Recovery is prepared and the owner is available for manual fallback.
Real logs/photos, commit/image hash and the Android return outcome are recorded.
Synthetic previews are not used as hardware evidence.
steps: Keep this stage gated until separately authorized.
Do not retry automatically after losing connectivity.
Record fail/inconclusive if XNU execution is not established.

tasks.title: Validate minimal XNU drivers on hardware
acceptance: Each subsystem is tested in a separate short experiment.
Recovery, timeout and stop criteria are known.
Android userdata is not formatted and UFS writes remain disabled.
steps: Start with RAM root/console and observed facts.
Do not combine touch, UFS and GPU in the first experiment.
Promote only verified results into status.

tasks.title: Prepare an extended read-only technical profile collector
acceptance: Commands only read technical metadata and do not invoke su/reboot/install/flash.
Vulkan hardware identifiers are removed before saving; device-tree properties use an allowlist.
Unavailable data is recorded as unavailable, not replaced by assumptions.
Tests cover sanitization, device-tree filtering and collection boundaries.
steps: Add CPU/GPU/kernel/storage/input/power metadata with provenance.
Test filters using synthetic fixtures.
Save actual device observations under DEV-001 separately from host tests.

tasks.title: Make English the project and agent working language
acceptance: Active documentation, task/source prose and generated CLI status use English.
Identifiers, commands, numeric observations, authorization boundaries and original evidence hashes are preserved.
English evidence translations point to immutable originals and do not claim new measurements.
Registry validation, relevant tests and local link checks pass.
steps: Translate maintained documentation, task specifications and registry prose.
Provide English views of historical evidence and the local device report.
Validate, regenerate status and record the language migration.
